# Assets

Place repository assets here:

- `logo.png` — Main logo (referenced in README.md)
  - Recommended: 512x512px PNG with transparent background
  - Used as: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Brashkie/signalis-core/main/.github/assets/logo.png`

- `banner.png` (optional) — Wide banner for social previews
  - Recommended: 1280x640px

- `og-image.png` (optional) — Open Graph image for link previews
  - Recommended: 1200x630px

## Usage in README.md

```markdown
<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Brashkie/signalis-core/main/.github/assets/logo.png" alt="Signalis Core" width="180" />
```

> ⚠️ Make sure files are committed to `main` branch for the raw.githubusercontent.com URLs to work.
